description: Get the user's loyalty program memberships and current point balances. Use this to personalize recommendations (e.g. "with 120k Bonvoy points, this Sheraton is a great points redemption") and to suggest portfolio optimizations. This covers points balances and elite tiers only — free night certificates are tracked separately and are NOT returned here; use get_free_night_credits for those.
name: get_loyalty_accounts
